entities.name: Nemanja Nedović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nemanja Nedović is a Serbian professional basketball player for AS Monaco of the French LNB Pro A and the EuroLeague. He also represented the senior Serbian national basketball team internationally. Standing at 1.92 m, he can play both the point guard and shooting guard positions.
